description: Upload a file (image/video/audio/file) from a URL and send it as a message. The tool handles the full two-step upload process automatically: 1) get MAX upload URL, 2) upload file, 3) send message with attachment. Provide either chat_id or user_id.

file_url.description: Public URL of the file to upload and send

text.description: Optional text caption for the media

type.description: Type of media: image, video, audio, or file

name: send_media
title: Send Media
